# a11y-audit

> Open, self-hosted accessibility regression evidence for large web estates.
> Template-aware sampling, stable finding fingerprints, and accepted
> baselines let CI block new barriers without requiring zero existing debt.

Documentation version: 3.0.0. Updated: 2026-09-05.
Requires Node.js 22.12.0 or later. Managed dependencies: Puppeteer 25.10.0
and axe-core 4.12.1. The reusable Action defaults to Node 22.
GitHub installs fetch main; pin the reusable Action to v3.0.0 for this release.

## What this skill does

- Scans web projects for accessibility violations using axe-core, with evidence matrices for WCAG 2.1 AA (default), WCAG 2.2 AA, and EN 301 549 clause 9
- Discovers site structure via sitemap.xml (or HTML crawl fallback)
- Classifies pages into template groups and selects representatives
- Produces structured reports with prioritized findings and fix guidance
- Tracks progress between audits (delta comparison)
- Creates reviewable accepted baselines and can fail CI only on new findings
- Installs the complete managed graph when packages are missing or skill-local Puppeteer is stale
- Managed graph excludes extract-zip; project/global fallback packages require their own dependency audit
- Browser downloads need installation authority; skip-download requires a matching preinstalled browser

## Where it fits

- Use Storybook or authored Playwright tests for component and interaction coverage.
- Use this project for repository-native evidence across large route and template sets.
- Use an enterprise platform for hosted monitoring, program dashboards, and managed manual testing.

## Boundaries

- Automated evidence does not certify WCAG or legal conformance.
- The skill reports findings and guidance; it does not modify application source.
- It does not provide hosted monitoring, VPAT generation, or screen-reader simulation.

## How to use

Try without installing: `npx skills use snapsynapse/skill-a11y-audit --skill a11y-audit`.
Install: `npx skills add snapsynapse/skill-a11y-audit --skill a11y-audit`.
For bounded assistant execution, fetch and GuideCheck-verify https://skilla11y.dev/.well-known/assistant-guide.txt before following it with per-action approval.
Claude Code project skills live in `.claude/skills/`; Codex project skills
live in `.agents/skills/`.

Prompt: "Run an accessibility audit on this project."

Scripts below are relative to the installed skill directory; invoke them with Node.js.
Argument names describe reviewed inputs, not literal placeholder values:

- `scripts/check-runtime.js`: verify the supported Node runtime
- `scripts/run-audit.js`: execute a reviewed JSON request; `--dry-run` inspects it without writes or network
- `scripts/discover.js`: use `--url` and optional `--group-map` for discovery
- `scripts/select-changed-surfaces.js`: use `--discover`, `--map`, and `--changed-files` or Git `--base`/`--head`
- `scripts/scan.js`: use `--discover` or `--urls`; `--baseline` with `--fail-on new` gates new findings
- `scripts/report.js`: use `--input` and `--output-dir`; `--standard` selects wcag21-aa, wcag22-aa, or en301549

## Key files

- [Assistant Guide](https://skilla11y.dev/.well-known/assistant-guide.txt): bounded assistant install, audit execution, and maintenance instructions
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/snapsynapse/skill-a11y-audit/blob/main/a11y-audit/SKILL.md): core skill instructions
- [scripts](https://github.com/snapsynapse/skill-a11y-audit/tree/main/a11y-audit/scripts): check-runtime.js, run-audit.js, discover.js, select-changed-surfaces.js, scan.js, report.js, bootstrap-context.js, plan-issues.js
- [Runtime compatibility](https://github.com/snapsynapse/skill-a11y-audit/blob/main/a11y-audit/references/runtime-compatibility.md): Node floor, managed dependencies, browser acquisition, and upgrade behavior
- [Interoperability adapter](https://github.com/snapsynapse/skill-a11y-audit/blob/main/a11y-audit/references/interoperability.md): strict JSON request, dry-run, stage results, and failure semantics
- [changed-surface selection](https://github.com/snapsynapse/skill-a11y-audit/blob/main/a11y-audit/references/changed-surfaces.md): ownership-map format and conservative fallback contract
- [route grouping](https://github.com/snapsynapse/skill-a11y-audit/blob/main/a11y-audit/references/route-grouping.md): route-pattern specificity and exact-page fallback contract
- [output contract](https://github.com/snapsynapse/skill-a11y-audit/blob/main/a11y-audit/references/output-contract.md): report format specification
- [output schema](https://skilla11y.dev/schema/audit-v1.json): versioned JSON output schema
- [reusable GitHub Action](https://github.com/snapsynapse/skill-a11y-audit/tree/main/.github/actions/scan): changed-surface selection, discovery, scanning, and accepted-baseline gating
- [validation workflow](https://github.com/snapsynapse/skill-a11y-audit/blob/main/.github/workflows/validate-skill.yml): Node matrix, GuideCheck, real-browser, consumer-Action, actionlint, and zizmor gates
- [sample output](https://github.com/snapsynapse/skill-a11y-audit/tree/main/a11y-audit/assets/sample-output): example report from a real site audit
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/snapsynapse/skill-a11y-audit/blob/main/a11y-audit/CHANGELOG.md): version history
- [MANIFEST](https://github.com/snapsynapse/skill-a11y-audit/blob/main/a11y-audit/MANIFEST.yaml): bundle inventory

## Report structure

The report includes Header, Executive Summary, Automated Scan Results,
the selected standard's automated evidence matrix, Manual Testing
Recommendations, Remediation Priority, Issues Created, and Methodology.
Comparable prior output adds Delta from Previous Audit. Findings, quick fixes,
color contrast, sampling, and shared-template evidence are subsections when
available. Empty or unsupported evidence is omitted or explicitly marked skipped.

## Output modes

- `markdown`: agent-delivered report only
- `markdown+json`: report + machine-readable data
- `markdown+issues`: report plus reviewed issue plans; live tracker writes need separate authorization

Direct `report.js` invocation always writes both Markdown and JSON.
The agent selects final delivery using the workspace context.

## Agent compatibility

- Claude Code and OpenAI Codex have bundled platform instructions.
- Other agents can read the Markdown skill or invoke the JSON adapter.
- Per-platform historical evidence lives in MANIFEST.yaml; this is not a claim
  that every agent or model has been tested with v3.
